text:
Evan: hit a flakey failure in the onboarding sample on Android 14 emulator after enabling R8. 401s trigger two refreshes and we see duplicate token exchanges. Repro notes below.

Lina: can you drop the minimal client config + logs?

Evan: client snippet: ```kotlin
val client = OkHttpClient.Builder()
  .addInterceptor(AuthInterceptor())
  .authenticator(TokenAuthenticator())
  .retryOnConnectionFailure(true)
  .build()
``` logs: ```
I/Auth: outgoing request with token=old
W/OkHttp: response 401 for /v1/resource
I/Authenticator: refresh start id=xyz
I/Authenticator: refresh done id=xyz
I/Auth: retry attaching token=old
I/Authenticator: refresh start id=xyz
I/Authenticator: refresh done id=xyz
W/OkHttp: response 401 after retry
```

Rob: classic race: interceptor reads token before authenticator finishes and spawns a retry, hitting the authenticator again. On device scheduling + R8 inlining widened the timing window.

Priya: quick suggestions: 1) make AuthInterceptor read token from an AtomicReference guarded by a refresh-in-flight flag; 2) limit authenticator activation to explicit WWW-Authenticate challenges; 3) flip `.retryOnConnectionFailure(false)` for auth-sensitive clients.

Evan: implemented a refreshMutex and disabled retryOnConnectionFailure for auth client. Flakiness drops a lot. CI run below.

android-ci: Build 3045 (emulator API 34) - onboarding-sample instrumentation: all tests pass.

Lina: also found an R8 keep rule was missing for com.redwood.sdk.auth.Token which changed its equals semantics under obfuscation. Add to proguard-rules.pro: ```
-keep class com.redwood.sdk.auth.Token { *; }
```

Rob: next steps: add an e2e test that simulates parallel 401s, document the interceptor vs authenticator guidance in the SDK README, and consider adding a helper factory like `AuthSafe.okHttpClient(...)` that sets these safe defaults.

Evan: will open tickets for tests/docs and a tiny RFC for the helper. Thanks all :thumbsup:
